73tommy_inline void tommy_arrayblk_grow(tommy_arrayblk* array, tommy_size_t size)
74{
75 if (size > array->count) {
76 array->count = size;
77
78 if (size > array->block_count * TOMMY_ARRAYBLK_SIZE)
79 tommy_arrayblk_reserve(array, size);
80 }
81}

169tommy_inline void tommy_arrayblk_insert_tail(tommy_arrayblk* array, void* element)
170{
171 tommy_size_t pos = array->count;
172
173 ++array->count;
174 if (array->count > array->block_count * TOMMY_ARRAYBLK_SIZE)
175 tommy_arrayblk_reserve(array, array->count);
176
177 tommy_arrayblk_set(array, pos, element);
178}
179
187tommy_inline void* tommy_arrayblk_remove_tail(tommy_arrayblk* array)
188{
189 assert(array->count != 0);
190
191 tommy_size_t pos = array->count - 1;
192 void** ptr = tommy_arrayblk_ref(array, pos);
193 void* element = *ptr;
194
195 /* keep unused slots zero so growing within capacity needs no initialization */
196 *ptr = 0;
197 array->count = pos;
198
199 return element;
200}
